Name: HQ Farmer Mod
Author: Asakohee
Description:
[center]

[color=#ffff00][size=4][b][/b][/size][/color][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]💛[/b][b]💛💛 About this Mod[/b][b] 💛💛💛 

[/b][/size][/color]Making your Farmer Sprite into high resolution

&

Providing additional customization
(makeup, socks and shoes, etc.)

&

Providing seasonal clothes and winter coats






[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]💛[/b][b]💛💛 Details[/b][b] 💛💛💛 

[/b][/size][/color][b][size=3][color=#9fc5e8]1️⃣ High-resolution character sprites for farmer[/color]
[/size][/b][size=2]① everything the original game has to offer, including skin color, eye color, etc.
② New Male and Female Farmer Body Design Offerings.
③ Dedicated hair, shirts, pants, accessories, and hat assets.[/size]


[size=3][color=#9fc5e8][b]2️⃣ [/b][b]A[/b][b]dditional customization options [/b][size=2][b](Using GenericModConfigMenu)[/b][/size][/color]
[/size][size=2]① Male Farmer winter coat[/size]
[color=#9fc5e8]▶ long coat
▶ half coat [/color]

[size=2]② Make up & [/size]Facial appearance
[color=#9fc5e8]▶ Eyebrow shape
▶ Eyebrow color
▶ Eye shape
▶ Eyeliner Color
▶ Eye shadow color
▶ Blusher color
▶ Mouth shape
▶ Lip color[/color]

[size=2]﻿[/size]
[size=2]③ Additional Costume Features[/size]
[color=#9fc5e8]▶ ﻿ Hosiery type
▶ Hosiery color
▶ Shoe Types
▶ Shoe color[/color]
[size=2](If set to default, follow the color of the in-game shoes item.)[/size]






[b][/b][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]💛[/b][b]💛💛 How to Use[/b][b] 💛💛💛 

[/b][/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=3][b]Just Unzip and paste into your Mods folder![/b][/size][/color][/center]

[size=2]

[b][Notes][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Hair and shirt assets are large, so I only worked on some of them. Some assets show original Stardew Valley content that doesn't fit your body shape when you choose.[/size]
[*][size=2]The hat asset was focused on the female farmer's fashion, but it can also be worn by male farmers.[/size]
[*][size=2]In the case of accessories, the first few are the same hair color, so it's hard to see. Please refer to them when you customize them. There are glasses and earrings on the back number.[/size]
[*][size=2]Characters you see when you load data from previous games have errors. When you run the play, it looks normal.[/size]
[*][size=2]GMCM allows you to adjust additional customization features in the in-game at any time.[/size]
[*][size=2]If you're slow to respond in the customization window, it's not a lag. I've set it up to update once a second to reduce the strain on my PC.[/size]
[*][size=2]Harmony updates, may not be compatible with other modes that modify the parameter asset.[/size]
[*][size=2]This mode was not manufactured in consideration of the multi-play environment.[/size]
[size=2]
[/size][/list][size=2]

[b][Now Working][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]NPC's HQ sprites.[/size]
[*][size=2]High resolution of all assets.[/size]
[/list]
[center][/center]
